instructions_to_main_agent: Implement French language UI for an automotive ecommerce MVP connecting agents and buyers via WhatsApp. Use standard Tailwind classes, strictly follow font and color guidelines. DO NOT use generic fonts for headings (use Cabinet Grotesk or Outfit). The Hero section MUST use a dark overlay over the hero image to ensure text visibility. Use Shadcn components for UI but customize them (cards with shadows and rounded corners). Ensure all interactive and key informational elements have a 'data-testid' attribute.

typography.font_strategy: Swiss Brutalist hybrid. High contrast between heavy headings and clean body.

scales.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tighter leading-none

spacing_and_layout.global: Generous spacing. Use p-8 to p-12 for main sections. Use max-w-7xl mx-auto for container.
spacing_and_layout.hero: min-h-[70vh] relative flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center px-4. Overlay: absolute inset-0 bg-black/60 z-0. Content must be relative z-10.
spacing_and_layout.hero_search_bar: mt-8 w-full max-w-4xl backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/10 border border-white/20 rounded-2xl p-4 flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-4 shadow-2xl
spacing_and_layout.vehicle_grid: lg:col-span-9 grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6

components.header: Crystal Glass style: sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-zinc-200 shadow-sm.
components.vehicle_card: bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.06)] border border-zinc-100 overflow-hidden group flex flex-col
components.card_image: w-full h-full object-cover transition-transform duration-500 group-hover:scale-105
components.buttons: rounded-lg font-semibold transition-all duration-200 hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:shadow-lg flex items-center justify-center gap-2

vehicle_detail_page.main_image: w-full aspect-[4/3] rounded-2xl overflow-hidden bg-zinc-100 object-cover

hero_background.description: Sleek sports car with illuminated headlights in dark urban parking lot

catalog_vehicles.description: White cadillac escalade driving on a highway
Matte black g-wagon parked on red carpet
Stylish black SUV parked on a quiet road by a dense forest

testing.rules: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='whatsapp-contact-btn').
